title: Society for Psychical Research and the history of psychical studies
summary: Ky Dickens tells of Society for Psychical Research and the history of psychical studies, about 1870s onward at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Studies have been going on since the 1870s the Society of psychical research

plain: A documentary maker named Ky Dickens, talking on Jesse Michels' podcast about her project on telepathy, meaning reading minds, says that serious study of such abilities goes back to the 1870s. She points to the Society for Psychical Research, a group formed to investigate claims of the mind reaching beyond the senses, and names thinkers Frederick Myers and William James as part of that history. Her point is that, if she is right, this is a long scientific tradition and not a new fad.
